findings.label: Min/Max span generality
findings.detail: release/amount Min/Max are computed over all 12 visible unit columns, whereas the sheet's 0.5hr summary cells reference MIN/MAX(B:G) (6 units). They coincide at the pinned 0.5hr row so the gold-value gate passes, but the general-row behavior is unverified. Author-documented. Confirm with QA that the 12-unit span is the intended reporting definition.

findings.label: Rounding expressed as attributes, not inline formulas
findings.detail: The brief phrases rounding as ROUND(...,3)/TRUNC(...,5) inside formulas; the implementation carries it as structured rounding attributes (conc_ppm round/3, rsd_std trunc/5, mean_bkt trunc/1, rsd_bkt trunc/5; replicate mean left raw). Functionally equivalent and confirmed correct against gold values. Noted only so a reviewer grepping formula strings does not mistake their absence for a gap.
